summary: The mechanical half of gap 4 is established by ./detected, ./accepted and ./clean. The other half is not: P20 requires every permitted root - including the scratch and image allowance of proposed change D3 - frozen identically across arms before probing, and this qualification has no frozen roots because it has no frozen targets, no cell image and no authorized dispatch.
establishes: That audit_reads has no acceptance path, on real transcripts, in both directions.
residual: D3 is undecided and must be decided by name before a freeze: either the frozen permitted roots include a named per-cell scratch directory, identical in every arm and named in the dispatch prompt, or they do not and there is no scratch. Note also what the audit is and is not - it reads the paths the session's file tools and shell actually addressed, so it is a transcript path detector, not an interpreter and not a proof against symlinks or arbitrary shell programs. P13 is why that matters: the interpreter reached those paths, and what stopped nothing here is the audit, which only records afterwards. Actual isolation is P16's regime.
read_from: the probe's own retained output, not asserted beside it
